desc: A scripted controller's press timed to its player's action command, not a frame (TTYD_P2_PRESS=a@ac, input_pc.c; the media captures' S3, S5 and tour beats 8 and 10): couch co-op, player 2 has Goombella, the auto battle takes Twin Bonk (TTYD_AUTO_DUO) in a Petal Meadows battle; controller 2 presses A at its half's mark, so the partner's half lands a Nice or better (2). Before: no way to time it but by frame, and a missed half was 0
log_must: \[input\] frame \d+: controller 2 a on its action command \(frames to the ideal press 0\)
